hook: Hindi has one word for both yesterday and tomorrow.
kicker: The same word covers both days.
payoff: It is कल, pronounced kal. The verb in the sentence tells you whether it means yesterday or tomorrow.
So there is no confusion: the time is carried by the verb, not by a second word.
